Economic slump
*21. SHRI JANESHWAR MISHRA:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the present
economic slow-down is due to absence of
any concrete economic policy to alleviate
this situation;
(b) if so, what steps have been taken to
cope up/solve these problems;
(c) whether Government are being
pressed to increase the capital expenditure
to tide over the present situation; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Release of exploratory location in
Contai by O.N.G.C.
*22. SHRI DIPANKAR
MUKHERJEE:
SHRIMATI CHANDRA
KALA PANDEY:
Will the Minister of PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) whether the proposal for release of
exploratory location in Contai block was
considered by ONGC in REXB meeting on
29th August, 2000;
(b) whether the proposal was purported
to release one B category and one A
category locations with target depth of 3800
m/trap;
(c) whether as a follow up action 2D
seismic data of Contai area was reprocessed;
(d) if so, whether there is any time
schedule for taking a decision on release of
location; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
Weak Cooperative banks
*23. SHRI KRISHNA KUMAR
BIRLA: Will the Minister of FINANCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
most of the Cooperative banks are weak;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government have
ascertained the causes of sickness of these
Cooperative banks;
(d) if so, the details thereof;
(e) whether the norms of RBI are being
flouted by most of the Cooperative banks;
and
(f) if so, the reasons therefor?
Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

Hijacking of Alliance airlines Mumbai-
Delhi flight
*24.SHRI NILOTPAL BASU:
SHRI S. NIRAIKULATHAN:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
had gone on record confirming the hijacking
of an Alliance Air late night flight from
Mumbai to Delhi;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it subsequently turned out
to be a case of false alarm;
(d) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor;
(e) the system which was in place at
the time of the incident and the details
thereof and the points at which this system
was breached; and
(f) whether any accountability has been
fixed?
Aircrashes of small aircrafts
*25. SHRI SURESH PACHOURI: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) what is the number of aircrashes/
mishaps relating to the small aircrafts being
operated by private companies during the
last three years;
(b) in how many of the above-mentioned
crashes/mishaps, the enquiry committees
have been set up and whether any reports
have been submitted by any of these
committees; and
(c) the status of the implementation of
recommendations of these reports and
whether in any of these reports submitted
by the committees, mishap/crash has been
attributed to the inexperience/under-
experience of pilots?
Unlicensed urban banks in Kerala
*26. SHRI A. VIJAYA RAGHAVAN:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether RBI has received any
complaint regarding the violation of norms
by the unlicensed urban banks’ started in
Kerala recently;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the total number of such banks
started throughout the country, State-wise;
and
(d) whether Government are
contemplating any steps to control such
’unlicensed urban banks?
Construction of mini-airport in
Gulbarga
*27. SHRI K.C. KONDAIAH: Will the
Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether the Airports Authority of
India had certified the suitability of land
acquired by the Karnataka Government for
the construction of mini-airport in Gulbarga;
and
(b) if so, whether Government have
given its approval to Jet airlines for operating
32 seater flights from Gulbarga to
Bangalore, Hyderabad, Hubli and Belgaum?
Helicopter services in North-Eastern
Region
*28. SHRI PRAKANTA WARISA:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) the number of places in NER which
are not connected by helicopter services;

9

(b) the number of places in NER which
are connected by the above services;
(c) whether there is any proposal to
start new helicopter services to the places
where no air/helicopter services are
available; and
(d) if so, by when and if not, the reasons
therefor?

Declaration of Tirumala as No Fly
Zone
136. DR. Y. LAKSHMI PRASAD: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Tirumala has been declared
as No Fly Zone as requested by the
Andhra Pradesh Government for security
reasons;
(b) if so, since when; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Airports in NER
137. DR. ARUN KUMAR SARMA:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the buildings and air-strips
of Airports in the NER, including Lilabari
Airport,  North Lakhimpur,  are operational;
(b) if so, the steps taken for air
connectivity with the rest of the country
and abroad;
(c) if not, the reasons therefor and
expected time by which the required
infrastructure will be in place; and
(d) the details of the ongoing
infrastructure projects in each of the airports
in the NER indicating amount sanctioned,
amount utilized, target works; target
achieved and time frame for completion of
each project?
Upgradation of Amausi and Babatpur
airports
138. PROF. (SHRIMATI) BHARATI
RAY : Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have decided
to modernise and upgrade Amausi and
Babatpur airports to meet international
standards;
(b) if so, what is the anticipated
expenditure; and
(c) by when the work is likely to start?
Indemnity to Air India
139. SHRI C. RAMACHAN-
DRAIAH: Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
has extended a $ 500 million indemnity to
Air India till November 30, while the same
has been declined to Indian Airlines; and
(b) if so, the reasons for declining it to
Indian Airlines?

32
WIN2\SESSION\3313RS 32
Prevention of terrorist attacks
140. SHRI C.M. IBRAHIM: Will the
Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether in the wake of Black-
Tuesday terrorists Aviation attack on
Americas prized towers of World Trade
Centre and the Pentagon-building,
Government had reviewed and put to test
and scrutiny the security measures put in
place after IC-814 hijack from Kathmandu
for aviation safety against terrorist attack
and hijacks;
(b) if so, how far the safety-measures
taken were found satisfactory, and
dependable to fore-stall and prevent any such
terrorist attempts; and
(c) what further steps have been taken in
light of the review ?
Security arrangements of airports
141. SHRI YADLAPATI VENKAT
RAO: Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether keeping in view the
disastrous attacks on World Trade Centres
and Pentagon in U.S., Government have
issued fresh strict instructions for security
checking at all airports of the country;
(b) whether Sky Marshals are posted
in all flights; and
(c) what other security/safety measures
have been introduced on plane flights to
ensure security?
Small aircrafts
142. SHRI SURESH PACHOURI: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) the number of small aircrafts under
operation with different agencies in the
country with year of manufacture/acquisition
by the agency;
(b) whether Government have set up a
high level Committee to look into
acquisition, maintenance and operation of
small aircrafts; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Streamlining of  IA
143. SHRI RAMA MUNI REDDY
SIRIGIREDDY: Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Indian Airlines is
heading for loss;
(b) if so, the reasons analysed for
incurring loss; and
(c) the action proposed to streamline the
organisation?
Introduction of Sky Marshals in
domestic airlines
144. SHRI C. P. THIRUNA-
VUKKARASU:
SHRI K. M. SAIFULLAH:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have any
proposal to introduce Sky Marshals in
domestic Indian Airlines; and
(b) if so, whether this will be extended
to private airlines for the safety of
passengers?

DGCA inquiry upto recent crash of
aircraft
145. SHRI K. KALAVENKATA
RAO:
SHRIMATI JAYAPRADA
NAHATA:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) what are the observations of the
enquiry conducted by DGCA about the
crash of aircraft killing Madhavrao Scindia;
(b) whether aviation safety precautions
are observed in India especially in small
aircraft; and
(c) if so, the cause of the crash analysed?

which are in the business of providing

(b) if so
